items.title: AI prescriptions: App to issue drugs without doctors' oversight in the US
items.excerpt: Utah has become the first US state to allow artificial intelligence to issue new prescriptions, and will soon let Nolla Health's app do so without any initial medical involvement.

items.title: Effect of Previsit AI-Generated Document Summaries on Consultation Time and Patient-Physician Communication: The AI-INFOCARE Randomized Controlled Trial
items.excerpt: A randomized trial tested whether AI-generated, quality-checked lay-language summaries of patients' medical documents, given before the visit, change consultation time and patient-physician communication.

items.title: AI-Assisted Molecular Review Refines SMO Inhibitor Candidacy in SHH Medulloblastoma
items.excerpt: NEJM AI case study (Buxbaum, Siegal et al.) in which an AI-assisted review of a patient's molecular profile refined whether an SHH-subtype medulloblastoma was a candidate for SMO-inhibitor therapy.

items.title: Clinical AI in 2025-2026: Six Themes from the SAIL Year in Review
items.excerpt: A NEJM AI perspective distilling six themes from the Symposium on AI for Learning Health Systems (SAIL) review of clinical AI deployment and evaluation over the past year.

items.title: A generalizable deep learning model for predicting opioid use disorder using language modeling for cross-EHR data harmonization
items.excerpt: OUD-REY is a deep learning model that uses longitudinal EHR data from the All of Us program, harmonized across record systems with language modeling, to predict a patient's one-year risk of opioid use disorder.

items.title: TrajOnco: a multi-agent framework for temporal reasoning over longitudinal EHR for multi-cancer early detection
items.excerpt: TrajOnco is a training-free multi-agent LLM framework that reasons over patients' longitudinal electronic health records to estimate risk across multiple cancers for earlier detection.

items.title: Researchers develop way of adapting adult radiology AI models to pediatric population
items.excerpt: Only about 17% of FDA-authorized AI medical devices are labeled for children; researchers describe a method to adapt adult radiology AI models for pediatric patients.

items.title: AI leads to lower turnaround times for high-volume imaging
items.excerpt: Multi-vendor AI implementation in radiology cut report turnaround times by up to 26% for trauma imaging, but infrastructure latency decided whether AI results reached radiologists in time to influence decisions.

items.title: HPI: Evidence contradicts broad claims about AI, radiology workforce
items.excerpt: The ACR's Harvey L. Neiman Health Policy Institute says claims that AI has reduced the need for radiologists are contradicted by rising imaging volumes, projected 17-27% demand growth by 2055 and climbing radiologist workloads.

items.title: 'AI sandboxes' are all the rage. Advocates scramble to control their future
items.excerpt: STAT's Health Tech newsletter on the groups vying to shape the rules for state health-AI regulatory sandboxes like Utah's, which let AI tools operate under relaxed oversight.

items.title: Why this startup is taking its AI to predict breast cancer risk directly to patients
items.excerpt: Rather than wait for doctors and insurers, Clairity is selling its mammogram-based breast cancer risk prediction AI directly to patients.

items.title: Why Agentic AI Works in Hospitals When You Strip It Down
items.excerpt: Hospitals running many simultaneous AI-agent pilots hit 'pilot sprawl', losing track of which agents are still in use; the piece argues for narrow, stripped-down agent deployments.

items.title: AI 의료기기 美 규제 대응, 변경관리·허가 지원 강화해야
items.excerpt: 미국의 AI 의료기기 전 주기 관리 기준(변경관리계획 등) 정비에 대응해 국내 기업의 변경관리·허가 전략 수립을 지원해야 한다는 제언이 나왔다.

items.title: 순천향대천안병원, AI기반 '지역 완결형 의료전달체계' 구축 본격화
items.excerpt: 순천향대천안병원이 AI·디지털 기술로 가정, 지역 공공의료기관, 상급병원을 연결하는 지역 완결형 의료전달체계 구축에 나섰다.

items.title: 메디컬에이아이, 심전도 기반 심부전 진단 보조 AI 'AiTiALVSD' 美 FDA 허가 획득
items.excerpt: 메디컬에이아이의 심전도 기반 좌심실 수축기능부전(심부전) 진단 보조 소프트웨어 'AiTiALVSD'가 미국 FDA 허가를 받았다.

items.title: 코어라인소프트, 日 최대 원격판독망에 'AVIEW CAC' 공급…실사용 기반 확대
items.excerpt: 코어라인소프트가 일본 원격영상진단 기업 닥터넷과 계약해, 닥터넷에 의뢰되는 흉부 CT에서 관상동맥석회화를 AVIEW CAC로 자동 정량화하고 결과를 원격판독에 연계한다.

items.title: 제이엘케이, '의료영상·임상 텍스트 통합 LLM' 특허 확보
items.excerpt: 제이엘케이가 EMR·EHR 텍스트와 PACS 영상을 병변 위치 정보 중심으로 통합해 토큰 비용을 줄이는 멀티모달 LLM 기반 임상 운영 시스템 특허를 확보했다.

items.title: 루닛, 난소암·방광암 AI 연구 발표…면역항암 치료반응 탐색
items.excerpt: 루닛이 SITC 2026에서 AI 바이오마커 플랫폼 루닛 스코프로 난소암(랩콥 공동)과 방광암의 면역항암 치료 반응을 탐색한 연구초록 2편을 발표한다.

items.title: Epilepsy domain adapted large language models enhance epileptogenic zone prediction from seizure semiology
items.excerpt: EpiSemoLLM, a domain-adapted language model externally validated across cohorts, localizes epileptogenic zones from seizure semiology comparably to or better than epileptologists.
